title: Fans Mistake Actress Kanikka Kapoor for Kiara Advani in Poster
summary: Fans mistook actress Kanikka Kapoor for Kiara Advani upon seeing the poster for the film 'Batwara 1947'. Some social media users questioned if artificial intelligence was used in the poster. The film's poster was released recently, featuring Kapoor. This confusion highlights a public perception issue regarding the actresses' appearances.
summary_points: Fans mistook Kanikka Kapoor for Kiara Advani in the poster for 'Batwara 1947'.
Social media users questioned the use of AI in the poster.
The poster for the film 'Batwara 1947' was recently released.
Kanikka Kapoor is featured in the poster for 'Batwara 1947'.
